hero.subtitulo: Is a 2D platformer with a pixel art aesthetic, where the goal is to guide the frog from platform to platform until you complete each level.
hero.capturaAlt: Screenshot of Frog Jumping showing the frog on a grass platform next to a tree
about.label: About the game
about.texto: Frog Jumping is a reflex arcade game with a pixel art aesthetic. The goal is to clear each level by reaching the end, until you complete every level in the game. It's a short project, focused on polishing the gameplay rather than the amount of content.
features.label: Features
features.f1Texto: Simple, responsive controls built for fast-paced runs.
features.f2Texto: Every level you clear raises the difficulty: stages become more complex and demanding.
features.f3Texto: Collect coins throughout the level to earn extra lives: every 50 coins gives you one more life.
features.f4Texto: If you lose all your lives, you lose your progress and have to start over.
